recipe.variant: Anima Preview 3 (base) as the official preview template ships it: 30 steps, cfg 4, er_sde/simple, 1024x1024 — for recreating images made with the preview models

unet_name.note: the preview model: anima-preview3-base (template), anima-preview2 or anima-preview — all three on Comfy Cloud; set the one the image was made with

prompt.note: Danbooru tags (lowercase, spaces not underscores), natural language, or both; tag order: quality/meta/year/safety, 1girl/1boy, character, series, @artist, general tags

sampler.note: the sampling method (ComfyUI's sampler list: euler, er_sde, euler_ancestral, dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu, …)

scheduler.note: the noise schedule (simple, normal, karras, beta, beta57, …)

width.note: the card: 'Works at resolutions between 512^2 and 1536^2 pixels'; the template rounds to multiples of 16

recipe.defaults_note: The template's subgraph flattened (no switches); the template differs from t2i-base in its model (anima-preview3-base) and sampler (er_sde). Seed, prompt and negative are the template's. Only the SaveImage prefix differs ('Anima' in the template).

vram_evidence.usage: NOT FOUND (no publisher VRAM figure; Comfy docs only say the 2B model 'runs comfortably on consumer GPUs')

verify: Built from templates/image_anima_preview.json on 2026-10-05; checked against the captured Comfy Cloud node list (0.38.2); checked by the plugin validators.
